# Images

A figure: an image on its own line, scaled down and framed, with its alt text as the caption.

![Sunset over the bay, generated for testing](images/landscape.png)

A tall image is capped at about a third of the screen, keeping its shape.

![A tall tree](images/tree.png "The tallest tree in the test set")

A small image stays small, never scaled up:

![Checkered icon](images/icon.png)

Images inside a sentence, like this ![badge](images/icon.png) one, stay as text chips.

A remote image is never downloaded:

![Rex logo on the web](https://example.com/rex.png)

A missing file says so:

![Lost image](images/nowhere.png)
